title: F2 polish · middleware strip spoofable x-praxis-* identity headers
goal: Defense-in-depth at the edge: delete incoming client-set x-praxis-tenant|role|account headers in middleware so they can never reach handlers, regardless of how a guard is written. x-praxis-signature (HMAC webhook) is preserved. Suggestion-only; no auto merge/deploy.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Middleware deletes x-praxis-tenant, x-praxis-role, x-praxis-account from inbound requests
x-praxis-signature is preserved (events webhook HMAC still works)
Existing request-auth spoof tests still pass (guards already reject; middleware is belt-and-suspenders)
Vitest covers header stripping; typecheck green
